mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_article (title, content, summary, category_id, cover_image, author_id, author_name, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{categoryId}, #{coverImage}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE my_article
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
summary = #{summary},
category_id = #{categoryId},
cover_image = #{coverImage},
status = #{status},
publish_time = #{publishTime},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE my_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE my_article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}

UPDATE my_article SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE article_id IN
#{articleId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalArticles, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as todayArticles, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) as totalViews, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) as totalLikes FROM my_article
